ui.title: HTTP Status Codes
ui.subtitle: A comprehensive reference of HTTP response codes with English descriptions, from informational (1xx) to server errors (5xx).
ui.emptyState: No status code found matching these criteria.

codes.name: Continue
codes.desc: The server received the request headers and the client should proceed to send the request body.

codes.name: Switching Protocols
codes.desc: The requester asked the server to switch protocols and the server has agreed.

codes.name: Processing
codes.desc: A WebDAV request may contain many sub-operations; the server has received the request and is processing it.

codes.name: Early Hints
codes.desc: Used to return some response headers before the final HTTP message.

codes.name: OK
codes.desc: The standard response for successful HTTP requests.

codes.name: Created
codes.desc: The request succeeded and resulted in the creation of a new resource.

codes.name: Accepted
codes.desc: The request has been accepted for processing, but processing is not complete.

codes.name: Non-Authoritative Information
codes.desc: The returned meta-information is not exactly what is available from the origin server.

codes.name: No Content
codes.desc: The server successfully processed the request but returns no content.

codes.name: Reset Content
codes.desc: The server processed the request and wants the client to reset the document view.

codes.name: Partial Content
codes.desc: The server sent only part of the resource due to a Range header.

codes.name: Multi-Status
codes.desc: The message body contains an XML message that can hold multiple separate response codes.

codes.name: Already Reported
codes.desc: Members of a DAV binding were already listed in a previous part of the response.

codes.name: IM Used
codes.desc: The server fulfilled the request for a resource and the response is a result of instance manipulations applied to the current instance.

codes.name: Multiple Choices
codes.desc: There are multiple options for the resource that the client can choose from.

codes.name: Moved Permanently
codes.desc: This request and all future requests should be directed to the new URL.

codes.name: Found
codes.desc: A common temporary redirect; tells the client to temporarily look at another address.

codes.name: See Other
codes.desc: The response to the request can be found at another address using the GET method.

codes.name: Not Modified
codes.desc: The resource has not changed since the version specified by the client.

codes.name: Use Proxy
codes.desc: The requested resource is only accessible through the proxy whose address is specified.

codes.name: Temporary Redirect
codes.desc: The request should be repeated with another address, but future requests should still use the original address.

codes.name: Permanent Redirect
codes.desc: The request and all future requests should be repeated with another address.

codes.name: Bad Request
codes.desc: The server cannot process the request due to a client error (such as malformed syntax).

codes.name: Unauthorized
codes.desc: Authentication is required but has not been performed or is invalid.

codes.name: Payment Required
codes.desc: Payment is required to use this service.

codes.name: Forbidden
codes.desc: The request is valid but the server refuses to allow access due to lack of permission.

codes.name: Not Found
codes.desc: The requested resource does not exist or could not be found on the server.

codes.name: Method Not Allowed
codes.desc: The request method (such as POST or GET) is not supported for this resource.

codes.name: Not Acceptable
codes.desc: The resource cannot produce content matching the client's Accept headers.

codes.name: Proxy Auth Required
codes.desc: The client must first authenticate with the proxy.

codes.name: Request Timeout
codes.desc: The server waited too long for the client to send the request and timed out.

codes.name: Conflict
codes.desc: The request cannot be processed because it conflicts with the current state of the resource.

codes.name: Gone
codes.desc: The requested resource no longer exists and has been permanently removed.

codes.name: Length Required
codes.desc: The request body length is not specified and the server requires it.

codes.name: Precondition Failed
codes.desc: The server does not meet the preconditions the client sent in its headers.

codes.name: Payload Too Large
codes.desc: The data sent by the client is larger than the server's allowed limit.

codes.name: URI Too Long
codes.desc: The length of the requested URL exceeds the server's allowed limit.

codes.name: Unsupported Media Type
codes.desc: The format of the sent data (Content-Type) is not recognized by the server.

codes.name: Range Not Satisfiable
codes.desc: The requested part of the file cannot be served by the server.

codes.name: Expectation Failed
codes.desc: The expectation specified in the Expect header cannot be met by the server.

codes.name: I'm a teapot
codes.desc: A standard internet joke (RFC 2324); the server refuses to brew coffee because it is a teapot.

codes.name: Misdirected Request
codes.desc: The request was sent to a server that cannot respond to it.

codes.name: Unprocessable Entity
codes.desc: The request is syntactically correct but semantically invalid (common in APIs).

codes.name: Locked
codes.desc: The resource you are accessing is locked.

codes.name: Failed Dependency
codes.desc: The request failed because a previous request failed.

codes.name: Too Early
codes.desc: The server is unwilling to risk processing a request that might be a replay.

codes.name: Upgrade Required
codes.desc: The client must upgrade its protocol for the server to fulfill the request.

codes.name: Precondition Required
codes.desc: The server requires the request to be conditional.

codes.name: Too Many Requests
codes.desc: The user has sent too many requests in a given time period (rate limit).

codes.name: Header Fields Too Large
codes.desc: The size of the request header fields exceeds the server's limit.

codes.name: Unavailable For Legal Reasons
codes.desc: A legal order has been issued to block access to this resource.

codes.name: Internal Server Error
codes.desc: A generic error; the server encountered an unexpected condition and no more specific message is available.

codes.name: Not Implemented
codes.desc: The server does not recognize the request method or cannot fulfill it.

codes.name: Bad Gateway
codes.desc: The server, acting as a proxy or gateway, received an invalid response from the upstream server.

codes.name: Service Unavailable
codes.desc: The server is temporarily unable to respond due to high load or maintenance.

codes.name: Gateway Timeout
codes.desc: The server, acting as a proxy, did not receive a timely response from the upstream server.

codes.name: HTTP Version Not Supported
codes.desc: The HTTP protocol version used in the request is not supported by the server.

codes.name: Variant Also Negotiates
codes.desc: Transparent content negotiation for the request leads to a circular reference.

codes.name: Insufficient Storage
codes.desc: The server is unable to store the representation needed to complete the request.

codes.name: Loop Detected
codes.desc: The server encountered an infinite loop while processing the request.

codes.name: Not Extended
codes.desc: Further extensions to the protocol are required to complete the request.

codes.name: Network Authentication Required
codes.desc: The client must authenticate to access the network.
